decisions.decision: Adopt B3 alone. Merge branch research/equal-blend-with-the-chain (code and tests 9b25221) into main so that RunSettings.blend_the_model_equally_with_the_condition_chain defaults to True, CONDITION_CHAIN_BLEND_WEIGHT stays the constant 0.5, and every other field is unchanged: separate_chains_for_growth_and_for_inflation_with_rates=True, random_seed 20260908, conditional_rate_shrinkage_strength 10, per-chain candidates 1..4, minimum_observations_before_first_fit 240, refit_every_n_months 12, R2 at ConditionChainCadence.EVERY_FORECAST_DATE. The default configuration hash becomes 7647c129be85291e; fec79a040f9ca6f9 (blend off) and ad7fcc1affd0746a (single chain) must still reproduce from their settings, and the omission-map entry at False keeps every digest main has written unchanged. Acceptance on merged main, before anything ships: `forecast check-gates` exit 0; `forecast baseline compare --require-own-artifacts --against reference-0008 --paired --benchmark model-sample` reads +0.0615, 90% [+0.0403, +0.0875], 96.67% [+0.0341, +0.0961] to the digit; the plain compare against the arm's own run outputs is identical field for field; the 34 fits under 7647c129be85291e are byte-identical to main's under fec79a040f9ca6f9 (copy them from the arm's cache only after a cmp check, otherwise refit); `forecast audit-look-ahead` exits 0 at 2000-03-01 and 2022-03-01 on main. Then capture `baselines/reference-adopted-blend` (json + forecasts parquet); do NOT recapture reference-0008, main, main-single-chain-d14 or a4-pre-d14. B1 is CONFIRMED_IN_SAMPLE and RECORDED-NOT-VOID (P2-9) but NOT adopted: its branch stays as a validated candidate, the way A2 did in 0002. B2 is not adopted (HARMFUL). No combination experiment is registered: B1's incremental value inside the blend is bounded by its pure regime effect (+0.0118 [−0.0242, +0.0528] on point-in-time rows, about +0.006 over all rows), which is a third of the detectable floor for a small perturbation (about 0.018 at 90%), so a run would return NOT SHOWN whether or not it is real. Verdicts on the adopted run: 0001 reads SHIP MODEL at one year and SHIP BASE RATE at five and ten (its gates as coded; at five years only calibration now fails); 0007 reads SHIP MODEL at one year (skill +0.2401 [+0.1715, +0.3113], slope 0.870 [0.603, 1.198], 4/4 robust, honesty 0.4575, chain gate −0.0077 [−0.0284, +0.0116]) and SHIP BASE RATE (R1) at five and ten. Both are printed; 0007 governs what ships. The forward register gains 7647c129be85291e as the shipped configuration from the next round (P2-6); fec79a040f9ca6f9 continues as a companion beside ad7fcc1affd0746a, because the two-chain adoption's falsifier and the model-versus-chain question both need the un-blended model forward.
decisions.reason: 0008's adoption clause admits an arm only on CONFIRMED_IN_SAMPLE, a clean review and no HARMFUL horizon; both B1 and B3 qualify, and 0007 is the rule that says what ships. On 0007 the two separate cleanly: B3 passes every one-year gate and is the only run configuration that ships the method at one year; B1 fails calibration (slope 0.651 [0.465, 0.880]) and would ship the base rate. B3 is also the smaller change (post-processing with a fixed weight, the model untouched, R2 already a reference column) and the registered prediction for it held. Adopting both without a run would be adopting an unrun configuration, and running the combination is underpowered by the project's own arithmetic. B3 is not shown to beat the chain alone at one year and is beaten by it at ten; that goes in the disclosure, not in the way of adoption, because 0007 fixed in advance that R2 reaches the submission only through a registered arm.
decisions.expects: Merged main reproduces the arm to the digit and both audits pass; 0007 reads SHIP MODEL at one year on the adopted run; the owner endorses B3 rather than reverting to the plain model.

decisions.decision: Re-ship now, under 0007, in one commit after P2-1's acceptance passes. First change `submit` so that a rule drives it: (1) `submit --rule {0001,0007}` with 0007 the default; under 0007 the per-horizon source comes from the successor_verdicts artifact and the base-rate rows carry the latest model_sample_climatology_probability (R1) per indicator and horizon from the backtest frame, exactly as latest_climatology does today for the series-start column; (2) the CSV gains explicit columns so nothing is mislabelled: probability, source in {'blend of regime model and condition chain', 'base rate (model-sample climatology, R1)'}, blend_probability, regime_model_probability, condition_chain_probability, model_sample_base_rate, climatological_base_rate (series-start, kept for 0001's audit), verdict_0001, verdict_0007, composition, effective_sample_size, distance_to_stationary; forecast_now must write both components beside the blend into current_forecasts; (3) the manifest records governing_rule '0007', verdict_by_horizon_0001, verdict_by_horizon_0007, base_rate_definition 'R1: expanding publication-aware climatology over the model's own sample', the two-chain regimes_by_chain, and shipped_under_authorisation. Verification, all committed with the change: a golden test that `submit --rule 0001` on the current artifacts reproduces the committed 2026-09-29 forecasts.csv byte for byte BEFORE the default flips; a unit test on synthetic artifacts that under 0007 the twelve-month rows equal current_forecasts' blend and the sixty- and 120-month rows equal the last R1 value for that indicator and horizon; `submit --verify-only` prints the governing rule and both verdict sets and agrees with the committed manifest; a refusal (P2-10) when today's fitted structure differs from the backtest's burn-in choice. Mechanics: `python3 .claude/hooks/freeze_guard.py --thaw "delegated re-ship under rule 0007: experiment 0008 adopted arm B3, the equal blend with the condition chain; 0007 reads SHIP MODEL at one year and R1 at five and ten" --subject submission/forecasts.csv --by "claude-fable-5-1 (delegated by Jeddy Xie, 2026-09-29)"`; `forecast submit`; set CONFIGURATION_HASH_APPROVED_FOR_SHIPPING to 7647c129be85291e; record in ADR 0013. Disclosure, in submission/README.md, forecasts/README.md, docs/RESULTS.md and the front README, in substance: 'Shipped under rule 0007, the successor to the frozen 2026-09-08 rule, by delegated decision P2-2. One-year rows are an equal-weight blend of the two-chain regime model and a regime-free two-rate chain on each indicator's own condition (experiment 0008, arm B3: CONFIRMED_IN_SAMPLE, +0.0615 over the model at one year, 96.67% [+0.0341, +0.0961]; every 0007 gate passes at one year). Five- and ten-year rows are the base rate over the model's own sample (R1); the blend fails 0007's skill gate there. The blend is not shown to beat the chain alone at one year (−0.0077, 90% [−0.0284, +0.0116]) and the chain beats it at ten years. Everything here is in-sample: the arm was designed after this sample's results were seen; the forward register, first resolving 2027-07-01, is the only out-of-sample test. Under the frozen 0001 the same run reads SHIP MODEL at one year and base rate at five and ten; both verdicts are in the manifest. Two small class-B approximations reach the chain half and are recorded (revised condition values, +0.0007; the recession announcement boundary, −0.0007); both are scheduled for correction and neither moves a verdict.'
decisions.reason: The submission is the outward claim and 0007 was registered to govern exactly this re-ship; waiting would leave a file that 0007 reads as base rate at one year while a registered, reviewed arm reads SHIP MODEL. The submit path must change because nothing in it reads 0007 or R1 today, and the B3 reviewer flagged that the blend would be mislabelled as model_probability; the golden test pins that the change moves nothing under 0001 before the rule flips, which is the only way to prove the new path is the old path plus a rule.
decisions.expects: The second re-ship lands this session with `submit --verify-only` clean on 7647c129be85291e; the golden 0001 test passes; the owner endorses the disclosure wording.

decisions.decision: Change nothing on this session's unregistered point estimate; register the comparison as experiment 0011 and run it after the integrity fixes of P2-6 land. 0011, 'the smaller model under the adopted blend', a family of one: change = 0006's switch restrict_the_two_chain_sweep_to_six_joint_states=True on top of the adopted default (blend on, everything else unchanged), the sweep's own rule choosing between 2x3 and 3x2 on the burn-in window as it did in 0006; primary = one-year paired difference, 3x2-blend minus the adopted 4x4-blend, on R1, 12-month blocks, 10,000 resamples, seed 20260908, 90%; reading rule fixed before the run: SMALLER MODEL ADOPTED if the one-year 90% interval's lower bound is above −0.02 (0002's and 0008's harm floor used as a non-inferiority margin, not a new number) AND no horizon's 90% interval lies entirely below −0.02 AND every 0007 one-year gate passes for the 3x2 blend AND both audits exit 0 AND the judged review is clean under the floor as read in P2-9; otherwise KEEP 4x4; INCONCLUSIVE if the fit or a gate refuses. Registered reasons for preferring the smaller model when not distinguishable: 27 free parameters against 58, about 142 months of effective sample per forecast against 46 (the dossier's failure mode 2), and 3x2 is interior to the 1..4 candidate range where 4x4 sits at its top (ADR 0010's boundary caveat). Stated in advance and disclosed: the unblended 3x2's one-year skill is already known to sit within 0.0001 of 4x4's, so NON-INFERIOR is expected (p = 0.75) and this registration cannot claim to predict it; what it fixes is the rule by which parsimony is allowed to decide. Secondaries: today's full-sample sweep must also choose 3x2 (it did in 0006), per-chain lambda2, and the R2 gap. If adopted, the 0006 branch's fixture edits come with it under P2-7's conditions. Updated adjudication text for the A4 dossier and ADR 0010, replacing the sentence 'The mechanism is presumed to be granularity, not timescale separation, until experiment 0006 says otherwise': 'Experiment 0006 (2026-09-29) read STRUCTURE HELPS: at the single chain's six cells, two chains at 3x2 beat it by +0.0587 at one year, 90% [+0.0216, +0.0934], on the same code and both audits. The adopted gain is the two-chain structure. The sixteen cells buy nothing measurable: the 3x2 model's one-year skill is within 0.0001 of the 4x4 default's on 27 parameters against 58, an unregistered point estimate that experiment 0011 tests under the adopted blend. Briefing 05's matched-cell arithmetic, which this adjudication cited, mixed a full-sample likelihood with a burn-in one; on the same panel the factorial six-cell model is about 0.4 nats per month better, and both records carry the dated correction.' Classification of the adjudication stays FACTUAL.
decisions.reason: Replacing the default on an unregistered point estimate is the forking path the project exists to refuse, and the number is known, so the only honest move is a registration that says so and fixes in advance what parsimony may decide. The sequence matters: 0011 must run against a reference that already carries the D5 and boundary corrections, or its numbers would move under it a week later.
decisions.expects: 0011 reads SMALLER MODEL ADOPTED and the default becomes the 3x2 blend with a new hash; today's sweep agrees with the burn-in choice.

decisions.decision: Close B2 as a negative finding and drop the state-space form. Record in changes.json and ADR 0013: 'Observing the unemployment rate and the term spread in the regime state space does not help at one year (−0.0088, 90% [−0.0414, +0.0250]) and harms at ten (−0.1176 [−0.1623, −0.0496]), on inputs the reviewer found free of look-ahead. The chain (R2) and the blend already read unemployment as a condition, which is where its information turned out to live (B1 +0.318 and B3 +0.213 on unemployment above five percent at the horizon).' Two things to keep from it: (1) the structure-instability observation, today's sweep choosing 4x4 where the backtest chose 3x3, becomes a standing refusal in submit (P2-10); (2) the sample-start comparability issue, R1 and R2 moving to 1956-03 with the arm's panel, becomes a dated clarification in 0007: for any arm that changes the panel's first month, R1 and R2 used in the paired comparison are computed on the reference's sample start, and the arm's own-start versions are reported beside them. Do not re-test unemployment as an observation. It may return only as a condition-side input inside a registered arm, and no such arm is scheduled.
decisions.reason: The registered prediction (no verdict 0.6, HARMFUL 0.15) was met on the pessimistic side; the harm sits at ten years where sixteen thinner regimes on five columns compound through the any-time path, and the one-year null says the regimes did not learn what the questions ask even when shown it. The two side findings are mechanical and cheap, and one of them is a dossier failure mode (state-count reselection) that now has a check.
decisions.expects: No registration revives unemployment as a model observation within the year; the submit refusal never fires on main.

decisions.decision: Keep 0007's registered fallback exactly as it stands for everything already registered under it (0008's arms and this re-ship): the slope test alone at 95%, recorded as passing a calibrated forecaster 77.5% of the time and erring against shipping. For claims registered after today, add a dated amendment to 0007 (before 0011 or 0009 registers) with a sized test: the same pooled logistic slope, but the pass criterion is that the slope's 95% moving-block lower bound exceeds c, where c is the 10th percentile of that lower bound over at least 1,000 perfectly calibrated simulated panels shaped like the sample (persistence and indicator mix as in research/briefings/derivations/sim_recalibration_test_size.py), so the test's size is 90% by construction; c and the simulation seed are computed and committed before the experiment runs; the size check must report between 88% and 92% on a fresh simulation seed or the amendment is not used and says why; the intercept stays out; ECE stays a reported diagnostic. c is recomputed whenever the sample changes (0009 extends it), because it is a property of the sample, not a threshold chosen from results.
decisions.reason: A test that fails a calibrated forecaster one time in four is a coin weighted against the method, and the registration said so rather than adjusting it; that stands for the results already read. Calibrating the critical value on the simulated null fixes the size without changing the statistic or inventing a number, and it is the smallest sized test available with the machinery already committed.
decisions.expects: The sized test's fresh-seed size lands between 88% and 92%; on the adopted blend at one year it agrees with the current test's pass.

decisions.decision: THIS SESSION, in order: (1) P2-1's merge, acceptance and capture of baselines/reference-adopted-blend; (2) P2-2's submit change and re-ship; (3) the forward round: register the shipped blend (7647c129be85291e) from submission/, and companions from forecasts/companions/: fec79a040f9ca6f9 (model alone) and ad7fcc1affd0746a (single chain), both written with `forecast submit --destination`; add an optional `forecaster` field to RegisteredForecast, defaulting to the existing source values so old lines parse, and include it in the dedup key; register R2 and R1 from the same round as companions written from current_forecasts' condition_chain_probability and model_sample_climatology_probability columns, carrying the producing run's hash and forecaster 'condition_chain' / 'model_sample_climatology'; `forecast resolve`; the round is dated the day it is made with data_as_of 2026-08-01, and the 2026-10-01 round then adds only what dedup admits; (4) records: ADR 0013 (adoption, re-ship, 0006's consequence, B2, the floor reading, D17), changes.json entries for CONTROL, B1, B2, B3, 0006, the reviews and 0010, ledger entries, the 0007 clarifications (P2-4, P2-9), forecasts/README.md and docs/RESULTS.md around the blend, the A4 dossier adjudication text (P2-3); (5) re-run measurement 0010 on the adopted blend under a dated amendment to its file that names the new default and keeps its reading rule, if the session has the eight minutes, otherwise on 2026-10-06. SCHEDULED: 2026-10-06 the D5 as_of-threaded condition read and the D17 provisional recession coding (P2-8), two separate commits, each measured with `forecast baseline compare --against reference-adopted-blend --paired --benchmark model-sample`, no verdict claimed from either, both audits at both cutoffs, then capture baselines/reference-2026-10-06; 2026-10-06 register 0011 and run it by 2026-10-09; 2026-10-13 register 0009 (CPIAUCNS, rules as fixed in P1-3) on whichever default 0011 leaves, run by 2026-10-20; 2026-10-21 pass-3 decision brief; 2026-11-01 the monthly round with all companions.
decisions.reason: Outward actions (adoption, re-ship, register) belong in one reviewed session so the record has one commit to point at; integrity fixes that move numbers by under 0.002 should not be mixed into it, and they must land before 0011 and 0009 anchor to a reference. 0011 goes before 0009 because the sample extension should test the model that will actually be shipped.
decisions.expects: Items 1–4 land this session; the 2026-10-06 fixes each move the one-year number by less than 0.002 with no verdict change; 0011 and 0009 run on their dates.

decisions.decision: Approve B3's test-fixture edits as part of the merge, on three conditions checked and recorded in the merge commit: (a) assertion counts in each edited existing file (tests/test_configuration_hash_compatibility.py, tests/test_two_timescale_chains.py, tests/test_look_ahead_audit.py) are identical as a multiset before and after, by the covenant's own regex, the way the A4 reviewer measured it; (b) the shipped-hash test still asserts the same digests for main's settings with every switch at its shipped value, and the omission-map test's exact set equality now names four entries; (c) any test or docstring that says 'three switches' is renamed to say four, so naming drift does not outlive the merge. B1's, B2's and 0006's fixture edits stay on their branches and merge with nothing; if 0011 adopts the 3x2 model, the 0006 branch's six fixture edits come with it under the same three conditions.
decisions.reason: The edits only name a new switch at False in fixtures that pin main's behaviour, add a set member and add a test file; the reviewer confirmed no assertion was removed or loosened. The conditions turn that reading into a measurement, which is what the covenant is for.
decisions.expects: Counts identical in all three files; the suite passes on merged main with zero skips added.

decisions.decision: Record it now as debt D17 in docs/TECHNICAL_DEBT.md ('Withholding recession months until their announcement is itself information once the publication gap is an input'), with the reviewer's measurements: 11 forecast dates (2003-01..07, 2010-08..09, 2021-06..07) where the chain starts 15–21 months back instead of the real-time 14; on main 51 reference rows move through the 2003-03-01 refit's rates; one-year shifts −0.000236 (B1), −0.000714 (B3); the live grid is unaffected because the announcement table holds only past announcements. Fix scheduled 2026-10-06 (P2-6): code the months after the last announced turning point provisionally by that turning point's phase instead of withholding them, implemented separately in walk_forward.publication_dates and in look_ahead_audit.perturbed_snapshot per ADR 0011's two-implementation discipline, with the side-by-side test extended to the four post-trough windows; measured against reference-adopted-blend, no verdict claimed; ADR 0011's sentence 'being late is never a leak' gets a dated correction: 'true while lateness is only a delay; false once how late a series is becomes an input, which R2's publication gap made it on 2026-09-29'. Do not block the re-ship on it: the effect is class B, under the floor, in the backtest only, and disclosed.
decisions.reason: The finding is real and the reviewer's mechanism is right, but its size is a third of the floor and it cannot reach the live grid, so it is a correction to schedule, not a reason to hold an outward action that is otherwise ready. Two implementations and a side-by-side test are how this project has kept the audit honest about the same series once already.
decisions.expects: The fix moves the adopted blend's one-year number by less than 0.001 and no verdict; the audit still exits 0 at both cutoffs.

decisions.decision: The class-B floor covers the paths a change OPENS: new reads of an approximation that the reference's forecasts do not make on the same rows. It does not cover approximations the reference already carries into the same forecasts through unchanged code, such as main's D5 exposure in the per-regime rates. Consequences: B1's verdict is CLASS-B RECORDED-NOT-VOID and +0.0530 (96.67% [+0.0172, +0.0934]) is its reported number; the wider measurement must still be REPORTED whenever a reviewer can compute it, in both directions (change-side only, and both runs), as the B1 reviewer did; and once a shared approximation is fixed on main, every open comparison is re-measured against the fixed reference, which for D5 happens on 2026-10-06 and makes this reading moot for B1. Record it as a dated clarification in 0007's look_ahead.materiality_floor, stating that it was applied to B1 after the fact and that the reviewer flagged the ambiguity. The 0.001 number does not move.
decisions.reason: The floor's own text says 'shared approximations'; a paired comparison cancels a shared exposure to first order, and the amount that does not cancel is a property of the reference's debt, scheduled for repair, not of the arm. The A4 review set the precedent that reusing main's rates on the same data opens no new route. Reading the floor more widely would let main's own debt void any arm that reads main's rates, which would make the floor a rule about main rather than about the change, and the two wider figures straddling the floor in opposite directions (−0.0011 change-side, +0.0011 both runs) is itself evidence they measure the reference's exposure.
decisions.expects: The D5 fix on 2026-10-06 re-measures B1 and B3 against the corrected reference with no verdict change; the owner upholds the reading.

decisions.decision: Five further items. (1) `forecast submit` refuses (exit 2, message naming both) when today's fitted state count or its factorisation differs from the backtest's burn-in choice; it is the check for the dossier's failure mode 6 and for what B2 showed (3x3 backtested, 4x4 today); on main both are 4x4 today. (2) The A4 dossier's outcome block stays empty until 2027-07-01, but its adjudication text is replaced by P2-3's wording and its 'failure mode 3 early warning has fired' sentence stays. (3) The forward register's README lists the blend as shipped, the model alone, the single chain, R2 and R1 as companions, and states which forward comparisons each serves: blend versus R2 (does the shipped method beat the chain), model versus single chain (the adoption's falsifier), model versus R2 (do regimes help). (4) The per-arm 0007 verdicts computed by the coordinator with main's code are recorded in changes.json as measurements with that provenance, since the arm branches predate 39dd1c8. (5) Nothing more is added to this pass: coupling, time-varying transitions and another economy stay where pass 1 left them.
decisions.reason: Each is a recording or a deterministic check that the results made necessary; the submit refusal is the only new code, and it is the kind of check the doctrine asks for when a failure mode has been named twice.
decisions.expects: All five land this session or with the 2026-10-06 commit; the submit refusal has a test that fires on a synthetic mismatch.

cautions: Merge only research/equal-blend-with-the-chain. B1, B2 and 0006 stay on their branches; their code and fixture edits merge with nothing until a registration adopts them.

Do not recapture baselines/reference-0008, main, main-single-chain-d14 or a4-pre-d14; every 0008 and 0006 number is anchored to them. Add baselines/reference-adopted-blend and, after 2026-10-06, baselines/reference-2026-10-06.
The fits under 7647c129be85291e may be copied from the arm's cache only after a byte-for-byte cmp against main's under fec79a040f9ca6f9; otherwise refit. Determinism is the claim; do not assume it.

The submit change is pinned by the golden `--rule 0001` test BEFORE the default rule flips; if that test does not reproduce the committed CSV byte for byte, stop and find out why before shipping under 0007.
Every register row is permanent. Check that the blend's rows carry the component columns and the `forecaster` field before appending; a mislabelled forward claim cannot be edited later.
The disclosure must say the blend is not shown to beat the chain alone at one year and is beaten by it at ten, and that every number is in-sample. Do not soften it into 'the model ships'.

0007's calibration fallback stays as registered for this re-ship; the sized test (P2-5) applies only to claims registered after its amendment, and the amendment must be committed before 0011 or 0009 registers.
The D17 fix must be implemented separately in the pipeline and in the audit, per ADR 0011, and both changes of 2026-10-06 are measured one at a time; do not fold them into one commit.
0011's registration must be committed before any 3x2-under-blend run and must disclose the known 0.0001 point estimate; its non-inferiority margin is the existing −0.02 harm floor, not a new number.

For any future arm that moves the panel's first month, compute R1 and R2 on the reference's sample start for the paired comparison (0007 clarification from B2); otherwise the benchmark moves with the arm.
The push of every commit here is the owner's. Every decision above is delegated and recorded as claude-fable-5-1's in ADR 0013, the ledger and the dossier; none promotes anything to E3.
